root_cause.text: In nvmet_bio_done(), calling nvmet_req_complete() before nvmet_req_bio_put() allows the completion callback to re-submit the same request and reuse its inline_bio, which then has its bi_blkg cleared by the subsequent bio_uninit() call, causing a NULL pointer dereference when the re-submitted bio accesses blk_cgroup_bio_start().
root_cause.evidence: The patch reorders the two calls, moving nvmet_req_bio_put() before nvmet_req_complete(), and the commit message explicitly describes the race sequence where queue_response re-queues the request and the later bio_uninit() sets bi_blkg to NULL, leading to the crash in blk_cgroup_bio_start().
